query:
INSERT INTO transition (transition_key, item_id, seq, attempt, from_state, to_state,
                                       to_detail, attempt_from, attempt_to, cause, effects_json,
                                       ts_ms)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT (transition_key) DO NOTHING
               RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
